name: ExplorationDrillProgramManager
tagline: Run every exploration drill program – holes, rigs, logging, assays and budget – in one Power Apps control.
description: A complete exploration drilling app for Power Apps and Power Pages: program progress and budget forecast, a hole board with drilling workflow rules, rig utilisation, core logging backlog and assay turnaround, and a full hole register with bulk actions. Works with demo data the moment it is dropped and connects to any collection, Dataverse table, SharePoint list or the Power Pages Web API.
features: Metres planned vs drilled per program
Budget spent, committed and forecast at completion
Status workflow with short-hole, rig and reason rules
Rig utilisation from drilling and standby hours
Logging backlog and assay turnaround flags
Dispatch / assays received / chase lab actions
Bulk assign rig, pad ready, dispatch, abandon
pack: Niray Mining & Natural Resources PCF Pack
react: 16.14.0 bundled (no platform library, no Fluent UI)
controlType: standard (2 controls: dataset + Power Pages field control)
